title: End-of-Sale & End-of-Life Notice for Zscaler Analyzer

blocks.text: Zscaler is announcing the End-of-Sale (EOS) and End-of-Life (EOL) dates for Zscaler Analyzer.

As of February 28, 2024, new downloads for the Zscaler Analyzer tool and functionality of the related zmtr.zscaler.com website will not be available. Existing deployments of Zscaler Analyzer will be supported until EOL on February 28, 2025.
If you are currently using Zscaler Analyzer, you must plan a migration to Digital Experience (ZDX).
